newsitem.title: CHINA: Agriculture Bank of China struggles to get deposit.
newsitem.headline: Agriculture Bank of China struggles to get deposit.

text.p: The Agriculture Bank of China is facing an uphill struggle to attract sufficient deposits to fulfil demand for loans and is also having difficulty raising the quality of its credit, the China Daily said on Friday.
By end-June its deposits increased by 97.7 billion yuan to reach 1.008 trillion yuan. Growth was down by 17.3 billion yuan compared with the same period last year, it said, quoting a bank official.
The bank had managed to increase deposits despite competition with other investment instruments such as stocks and bonds, the official said.
However, he said the bank has seen a steady decline in the ratio of deposits to loans and faces an uphill struggle to arrest that decline.
Loans reached 47.6 billion yuan by end-July, he said.

Even with a squeeze on capital in sight, the bank must issue another 72 billion yuan in loans in the second half of the year while paying back loans from the central bank, the People's Bank of China, and selling off remaining underwritten state debt, he said.
The bank had seen no marked improvement in credit quality but was determined to fulfil a target to cut its bad debt level by two to three percent, he said without giving further details.
